rounds.text: Conceded: [E14, E15, E16, E17, E18, E19, E56]. Despite strong reported profit growth numbers, Shanti Gold International Ltd suffers from a severe divergence between earnings and actual cash generation, with operating cash flow collapsing to negative ₹261 Cr in March 2026 and a cash conversion ratio of -1.86x [E27, E28, E29, E30]. This alarming disconnect is compounded by explicit flags that the company might be capitalizing interest costs and that working capital days have worsened significantly from 47.7 days to 89.7 days [E54, E55]. Institutional confidence is visibly eroding as foreign and domestic institutional investors have cut their holdings by 0.76 and 2.43 percentage points respectively, driving negative money flow signals [E35, E36, E37]. Furthermore, the company pays a 0.00% dividend yield despite reporting repeated profits, keeping all capital locked inside a cash-burning operational structure [E4, E53]. Geopolitical volatility has already forced delays in the incorporation timeline of the Dubai subsidiary to June 2026, highlighting external vulnerabilities in international expansion plans [E84, E85].

Conceded: [E19]. Despite reported compounding profits, Shanti Gold International Ltd suffers from a severe cash flow disconnect, posting a negative operating cash flow of Rs -261 Cr and a free cash flow of Rs -267 Cr in Mar 2026 [E28, E29]. This translates to a dismal cash conversion ratio of -1.86x against reported profit, meaning operating cash flow represents -111% of operating profit [E27, E30]. Furthermore, working capital pressures are mounting with working capital days jumping significantly from 47.7 days to 89.7 days [E55]. Institutional confidence is actively eroding, evidenced by foreign institutions cutting their stake to 1.92% from 2.68% and domestic institutions slashing theirs to 1.58% from 4.01% [E35, E36], triggering negative institutional money flow [E37]. Finally, the data provider explicitly flags that the company might be capitalizing interest costs [E54] and paying a dividend yield of 0.00% despite reported earnings [E4, E53].
